# Complete Make prerequisite source fixture

The complete `Makefile` and `LICENSE` are retained byte for byte from
https://github.com/dotabuff/yasha at commit
`61b571f7056d01ff1b74fd46e788d0b55664d155`.
The source is licensed under the MIT License, copyright 2014 Elo Entertainment LLC.
This fixture preserves 895 physical bytes and 26 paired CRLF line endings.
Its SHA256 is `9bbf2485e2d405d798d769cfd08b884850f529fdd70df145fec63139e810c65b`.

The written `default : test` normal prerequisite has owner Definition 73..80,
operand 83..87, and target Definition 91..95. The declaration is not a lexical
containment, shell call or proof that a recipe executes. Wildcard expansion,
automatic variables, included makefiles and recipe behavior remain unqualified.

GNU Make documents the distinction between normal dependency prerequisites and
order-only prerequisites at
https://www.gnu.org/s/make/manual/html_node/Prerequisite-Types.html and the rule
syntax at https://www.gnu.org/s/make/manual/html_node/Rule-Syntax.html.
